title: The REET 2021 Paper Leak Scandal
dek: Rajasthan's teacher-eligibility exam for roughly 16 lakh candidates was hit by a paper leak allegedly distributed for cash before the test even began, forcing a board chairman's dismissal, over 35 arrests, and a partial re-exam of the affected exam level.

reality.description: REET 2021 was held on 26 September 2021. In Gangapur City, Sawai Madhopur district, the question paper was allegedly leaked around 8:30 am — roughly 90 minutes before the 10 am start — and found in the possession of a serving police constable, Devendra Singh, who allegedly distributed it to candidates for payment. The Rajasthan Police's Special Operations Group (SOG) investigated, arresting more than 35 people, including alleged mastermind Batti Lal Meena, who was arrested in Uttarakhand's Kedarnath. The state government dismissed BSER chairman D P Jaroli and suspended board secretary Arvind Kumar Sengwa over the leak. On 7 February 2022, then-Chief Minister Ashok Gehlot announced cancellation of the Level-2 REET exam and its reconduct for an expanded 62,000 posts (up from 32,000). Opposition BJP leaders demanded a CBI probe, which the state government did not hand over; the case remained with the SOG. This entry has not been able to confirm the current trial stage or any convictions arising from the SOG's 2021–22 arrests.

gap.note: The government nearly doubled the number of posts in the reconducted Level-2 exam, reflecting both the scale of the disruption and an attempt to absorb the delay's political cost.
